audit.whatIsWrong: Three fields tell the player Depth Charge cannot be parried. whys[4] calls it 'undodgeable and unparriable', spikes[2].text calls it 'an undodgeable knock-up she cannot parry', and mid calls it 'the piece she cannot answer: no parry'. Riot's Riposte text says she parries ALL incoming damage and disables, and that the follow-up stab STUNS if Riposte blocked an immobilizing effect. Depth Charge is exactly that — a knock-up and a stun.
audit.why: This is the most dangerous line in the entry. It tells a Nautilus to fire his 120-second ultimate into a held parry, which does not merely whiff — it hands Fiora a free stun on him in the middle of her all-in. The correct rule is the opposite of what the page says: bait Riposte first, then commit.
audit.corrected: All three fields rewritten to state that Riposte catches Depth Charge and returns a stun, and that the R goes in only after the 24-second parry is spent. The early block already had this right for the Q hook and was left alone.
sources: ownerKit R text and hardCC flag

audit.whatIsWrong: Riposte is the tracked ability in a dozen fields and never carried a cooldown, and neither did Lunge.
audit.why: Riposte is 24 seconds at rank 1 — an enormous window for a champion whose whole plan is one landed hook. Lunge starts at 13s and drops to 6s, which is why her spacing gets harder to punish as the lane goes on.
audit.corrected: 24s and 13s written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, whys[4] and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0, 2 and 6 disagreed with the whys and with the mirror: whys[0] says Fiora's trade 'walks off before you can answer' under a 'Skill' token; whys[2] calls level 3 'a genuine coin-flip' under 'Fiora'; whys[6] says the R-led chain flips the game under 'Fiora'.
audit.why: The mirror audit (fiora__nautilus) already settled these three rows as Fiora / Skill / Nautilus, and packet.levelChart agrees. Restating them from this side keeps the two pages consistent.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 2 and 6 set to Fiora, Skill and Nautilus in BOTH layers as matched pairs, with ratings adjusted.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[2] is titled 'Stack pure HP vs vitals' and carried unrelated boilerplate about whiffing hooks, and report[8].t said 'his healing fights your grind'.
audit.why: Lunge applies on-hit effects, so Fiora's damage scales with attack speed and on-hit items rather than raw AD — armour reads the trade wrong, which is what the missingInteractions on-hit rule is pointing at. Her passive heals her on every Vital hit, so the Grievous Wounds call is right but was never tied to the actual mechanic.
audit.corrected: The Don't now states the on-hit scaling; itemisation ties Bramble Vest to Vital healing.
sources: enemyKit Q onHit flag and text

edits.before: Depth Charge is undodgeable and unparriable, but Fiora's mobility and vital pressure keep it even — your edge is the pick, not the duel.
edits.after: Depth Charge is undodgeable, but Riposte parries it and stuns you back — bait the 24s parry first. Your edge is the pick, not the duel.

edits.before: Depth Charge is your get-out-of-jail engage — an undodgeable knock-up she cannot parry, the moment your CC chain truly threatens a kill or a gank.
edits.after: Depth Charge is your get-out-of-jail engage — undodgeable, but only once Riposte is spent, because parrying an immobilise turns it into a stun on you.

edits.before: This is your window, even though the raw duel stays a coin-flip. The lever isn't your damage, it's her W — bait the parry on a meaningless E shockwave or an early Q on the wave, then commit the real Q-pull. At 6, Depth Charge is the piece she cannot answer: it's homing and undodgeable, no parry, no Q-dash out of it, so it converts your lane pressure into kills and repeated ganks. Play for picks and the jungler here; you are FAVOURED on the scoreboard because you turn one landed combo into a dead Fiora, not because you win the straight fight.

notes: The critical fix: three fields told the player Depth Charge is unparriable. Riposte parries all incoming damage and stuns if it blocked an immobilizing effect, so firing a 120-second ultimate into a held parry hands Fiora a free stun — the page had the single most important rule of the matchup exactly backwards. The early block already stated the rule correctly for the Q hook, which is how the contradiction was visible inside one entry. Also NOT written, following the mirror: missingInteractions suggests Dredge Line denies Lunge's mobility — Dredge Line displaces, it does not ground, so no such claim appears anywhere. Left alone as unverified: the 'percent-max-HP true damage' framing of Vitals, which is stated in several existing fields but is not in Riot's passive text (the trueDamage flag sits on Grand Challenge, whose description mentions only reveal and healing) — I neither strengthened nor deleted it.
